steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Countryside in Filter environments. Click The Countryside, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Stand the Sunflower up. Put the Sun above it and the Water Jug by its stem. Put the C02 Molecule and the Glucose Model by a leaf.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The plant uses ___, ___ and ___ to make ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add oxygen, the gas a leaf gives off. Type zero, 2: 02 Molecule

vr.full: Your photo shows the Sunflower with all 4 models around it.

studio.title: Stock the factory

labels.done: Sunlight, water and air are in. Now the leaves can make sugar!
labels.q1: Does the plant use it to make food?

studio.look: A factory is a place where things get made. A plant is a food factory. An ingredient is something you need to make something. One card comes up at a time.
studio.do: Tap where the card goes, or drag the card there. For each ingredient, tap the part that takes it in.

card.name: Sunlight
card.alt: Bright sun shining through clouds in a blue sky

pairs.ok: In! A plant needs sunlight to make food.
pairs.miss: Try again. Think about a plant kept in the dark.
pairs.placeMiss: Think about which part faces the sun.

card.name: A sandwich
card.alt: Toast sandwich on a white plate

pairs.ok: Right! Animals eat food. A plant makes its own.
pairs.miss: Not this time. A plant never eats. It makes its own food.

card.name: Water
card.alt: Water pouring from an orange watering can onto garden plants

pairs.ok: In! A plant needs water to make food.
pairs.miss: Try again. Think about a plant nobody waters.
pairs.placeMiss: Think about which part is down in the wet soil.

card.name: Soil
card.alt: Two hands holding dark garden soil

pairs.ok: Right! Soil holds the plant and its water. The food is not made of soil.
pairs.miss: Not this time. Roots take water from the soil. They do not eat the soil.

card.name: Air
card.alt: Blue sky with small white clouds

pairs.ok: In! A plant uses a gas from the air called carbon dioxide.
pairs.miss: Try again. Leaves have tiny openings. What comes in through them?
pairs.placeMiss: Think about which part has tiny openings.

card.name: Sugar
card.alt: Clear white sugar crystals up close

pairs.ok: Right! Sugar is what the plant makes. It comes out at the end.
pairs.miss: Not this time. Sugar is the food the leaves make. It is not an ingredient.

studio.full: You sorted all 6 cards and picked the part for each ingredient. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the field, crew. We film Scene 19, The Food Factory. Show me what a plant uses to make food, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Countryside, and pick The Countryside. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Stand the sunflower up first. Put what goes in around it. Hold the sugar by a leaf. Then tell me the recipe.
voice.extra: Got time? Add the gas a leaf gives off. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Sort each card in or out. Then tell me what you think.
